title: PSA: Change your font
author: AlgaeNo3373
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/br060ojp1bsh1.png?width=1896&format=png&auto=webp&s=2323264f6963108d707b12ef73102ccc5e8ee1d7

Most vibe coded stuff uses the same font (Inter/System). It plays a role in every vibe coded thing "looking the same".   
  
[dafont.com](http://dafont.com) is an example of a website where you can browse/preview fonts, including ones that are 100% free to use. 

When it comes to iterating a game, picking a typography style is very low hanging fruit and easy to do, yet most vibe coders never seem to think about it.    
  
My suggestion is to find a few to trial, put a font changer tool in your game to preview them, then lock in something other than the same font 99% of vibe coders use (Inter/System). It's a one-shot improvement that can go a long way.

comments.author: SuperCamouflageShark
comments.body: If i pick a new font for my game to use, does it get packaged in the game so others automatically download it if they don't have it on their system?

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: Usually you bundle font/s in with your build by default yes, but it's worth checking this is enabled. F,ex on the web you can embed/load a font with the game so it displays regardless of what's installed locally, same true of engines like Unity/Godot.
